died.name: Fisher Ames
died.desc: member of the U.S. House of Representatives
died.last_words: I have peace of mind. It may arise from stupidity, but I think it is founded on a belief of the Gospel. My hope is in the mercy of God through Jesus Christ.

died.name: John Adams
died.desc: Founding Father and second president of the United States
died.cause: unaware that Jefferson had died earlier that same day

died.name: James Monroe
died.cause: referring to his close friend James Madison
died.last_words: I regret that I should leave this world without again beholding him.

died.name: Henry Montgomery Lawrence
died.cause: mortally wounded at Siege of Lucknow
died.last_words: Let there be no fuss about me; let me be buried with the men.

died.name: Alfred Loewenstein
died.cause: The 51-year-old financier and third-richest man in the world at the time, died while flying from England to Belgium on his private Fokker F.VII airplane. It is believed he fell out of the aircraft and into the water where he died.

died.name: Marie Skłodowska Curie
died.cause: upon being offered a painkilling injection

died.name: Frank McAteer
died.cause: to suspect who resisted arrest; McAteer then collapsed from a heart attack
died.last_words: You know, it's people like you who put peace officers in hospitals or drive them to Pueblo.

died.name: Reginald Tucker
died.cause: The 29-year-old lawyer, who raced along a Chicago skyscraper corridor without wearing his glasses, crashed through a window and plunged 39 stories to his death during an early Fourth of July party. Police said portions of the man's body were scattered around the street near the 41-story Prudential Building in the city's downtown area. Several horrified onlookers attending holiday celebrations heard the glass shatter and saw him fall to his death.

born.name: Paul Scarron
born.last_words: Ah! mes enfans, you cannot cry as much for me as I have made you laugh in my time! I never thought that it was so easy a matter to laugh at the approach of death.

born.name: Christian Fürchtegott Gellert
born.cause: on being told he had only an hour to live
born.last_words: Now, God be praised, only one hour!

born.name: Thomas John Barnardo
born.desc: Irish-born British philanthropist, founder of the Barnardo's charity
born.last_words: Syrie, my head is so heavy. Let me rest it on your face.

born.name: Calvin Coolidge
born.cause: to a carpenter working on his house
